questions.question: How was Hana saved as a child?
questions.subject: Hana Kurusu/Synopsis

answer.item: Remaining silent to survive, Hana lived like this for about one year until she was saved by a similarly young Megumi Fushiguro, who used his white dog shikigami to lead her into escaping.

questions.question: What allowed Hana to travel between colonies during the Culling Game?
questions.subject: Hana Kurusu/Synopsis

answer.item: Through her ability to cross Colony borders via the Angel's technique, Hana eventually travels from Tokyo's No. 2 to the No. 1 Colony, where she encounters Megumi as he collapses from exhaustion in an alleyway, after his fight against Reggie Star.

questions.question: How was Hana killed during the Culling Game?
questions.subject: Hana Kurusu/Synopsis

answer.item: whereupon Sukuna critically wounds and dispatches the girl, causing her to fall off the rooftop they were on.

questions.question: Who healed Hana before the Shinjuku Showdown?
questions.subject: Hana Kurusu/Synopsis

answer.item: Hana was later healed by Yuta Okkotsu and Shoko Ieiri after being saved earlier by Rin Amai and possibly Takaba.

questions.question: What did Hana misunderstand when Megumi offered to be her 'right arm'?
questions.subject: Hana Kurusu/Synopsis

answer.item: Hana misinterpreted this as a marriage proposal and asked when their ceremony would be, flustering Megumi in return, causing him to stutter before leaving for his mission.
Hana passed away some time before 2087.
